context:
Goal: q_max's browser checks run fast, and the records say what CI really does.
Problem (rule): q_max #1040 splits the browser suite into 7 groups that run at once: 21 min 35 s, against 3 h 15 min before (runs 42312090233 and 42274824088). It rewrites one sentence of D-542 (the browser tier runs on your dispatch): the 240-minute limit becomes the 7-group split. q_max's CLAUDE.md needs your look at a rewritten entry before it merges.
Based on (measured): the two CI runs above.
Departs from: q_max main, D-542 states a 240-minute bound — changes to the 7-group split.
Also: 3 checks fail only in the split, probably from state shared across groups. They are listed in q_max specs/todo.md.

options.label: No, keep the old sentence
options.lose: The record states a time limit CI no longer has.

title: OK the one-sentence D-542 edit in q_max #1040?
